description: Before choosing what to do, understand what matters, what is changing, and what may be getting in the way.

paragraphs.text: Before choosing what to do, understand what matters, what is changing, and what may be getting in the way.
Separate the important from the merely urgent.
Bring relevant information, priorities, assumptions, and constraints into view.
Recognize recurring issues and relationships that fragmented information can hide.
